description: A simple app that converts your text to speech. Run the app, type your text using the keyboard, and press the "Save" button—Flipper Zero will play back the text in audible form.
name: Text to SAM
short_description: Convert text to speech on your Flipper Zero with SAM (Software Automatic Mouth).
